en.headline: Man dies after being rescued from sea near Ting Kau Bridge
en.dek: Tsing Ma control area staff found an empty seven-seater on the hard shoulder towards Tuen Mun around 1 a.m.; marine police later pulled a 35-year-old man from the water.
body: A 35-year-old man died after being rescued from the sea near Ting Kau Bridge early on Wednesday.

Tsing Ma control area staff reported at about 1:16 a.m. that a seven-seater vehicle was parked on the hard shoulder towards Tuen Mun with no one inside. They suspected someone had jumped from the bridge and called for help.

Marine police and rescuers searched the area and pulled an unconscious man from the water nearby. He was taken to Yan Chai Hospital, where he was later certified dead. Police found no suicide note in the vehicle and are investigating the circumstances.
The vehicle remained on the bridge while officers examined the scene.

zh.headline: 汀九橋男子疑墮海 水警救起後證實不治
zh.dek: 青馬管制區職員約凌晨1時發現往屯門方向路肩有無人七人車，水警其後在附近海面救起35歲男子。
body: 一名35歲男子周三凌晨在汀九橋附近墮海，獲救後證實死亡。
青馬管制區職員約凌晨1時16分發現往屯門方向橋面路肩停有一輛七人車，車內無人，懷疑有人跳橋，隨即報案。
水警及救援人員到場搜索，其後在附近海面救起陷入昏迷的姓姜男子，送往仁濟醫院，最終證實不治。警方在車內未發現遺書，正調查事件經過。
涉事車輛仍停在橋上，警員在現場調查。
